description: This is a Database variable in sync with a databse table, can be used to all the CRUD operation like create, read, update, delete a record from database.

methods.name: listRecords
methods.description: This method updates the Variable’s dataSet with new data by making a call to the Live DB Service.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: The object can have fields as filterFields - key-value pairs of fields for filtering read calls as {“key”: “value”}
an optional callback method called on successful invocation of the variable.
an optional callback method called on error invocation of the variable.

examples: var lv = Page.Variables.HrdbEmployeeData;// Example 1: Get all data for Employees tablelv.listRecords({}, function(data) { // Success Callback console.log('success', data) }, function(error) { // Error Callback console.error('error', error)});var lv = Page.Variables.HrdbEmployeeData;// Example 2: Set custom page and sizelv.listRecords({ "page": 2, "pagesize": 5 }, function(data) { // Success Callback console.log('success', data) }, function(error) { // Error Callback console.error('error', error) });var lv = Page.Variables.HrdbEmployeeData;// Example 3: Get data filtered on the table fieldslv.listRecords({ filterFields: { "city": { "value": "New York" } } }, function(data) { // Success Callback console.log('success', data) }, function(error) { // Error Callback console.error('error', error) });
lv.listRecords({ filterFields: { "deptId": { "value": 1, "matchMode": "EQUALS" }, "empId": { "value": 1, "matchMode": "GREATER_THAN" } }, orderBy: "empId desc, firstname desc"});

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: This method creates a record and insert the row in the variable's source table

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: This object can have fields as a row - record object as {"field": "value"}. Complete record object should be passed along with the primary key.
an optional callback method called on successful invocation of the variable.
an optional callback method called on error invocation of the variable.

examples: var lv = Page.Variables.HrdbEmployeeData;// Example 1: Insert a record into Employee tablelv.createRecord({ row: { 'firstname': "Steve", 'lastname': "Rogers", "username": "steve.rogers" }}, function(data) { // Success Callback console.log("Successfully inserted employee:", data); // Output: // Successfully inserted employee: {empId: 11, firstname: “Steve”,...}}, function(error) { // Error Callback console.error("error while inserting employee", error)});

var sv = Page.Variables.[variable_name]; sv.createRecord({ "row": { "fname": "Steve", "lname": "rogers" } }, function(data) { console.log("creaded row", data); }, function(error) { console.log("error", error) });
var sv = Partial.Variables.[variable_name]; sv.createRecord({ "row": { "fname": "Steve", "lname": "rogers" } });

methods.name: deleteRecord
methods.description: This method deletes the record with the passed row primary key valueed row in variable's source table

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: This object can have fields as a row - record object as {"field": "value"}. Complete record object should be passed along with the primary key.
an optional callback method called on successful invocation of the variable.
an optional callback method called on error invocation of the variable.

examples: var lv = Page.Variables.HrdbEmployeeData;// delete a recordlv.deleteRecord({ row: { "empId": 11 // primary key } }, function(success) { // Success Callback console.log("successfully deleted employee (boolean)", success); }, function(error) { // Error Callback console.error("error while deleting employee", error)});
var sv = Page.Variables.[variable_name]; sv.deleteRecord({ "row": { "emp_id": 21 } }, function(data) { console.log("deleted row", data); }, function(error) { console.log("error", error) });
var sv = Partial.Variables.[variable_name]; sv.deleteRecord({ "row": { "emp_id": 21 } });

methods.name: updateRecord
methods.description: This method updates the variable's source table record with passed json row data

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: This object can have fields as a row - record object as {"field": "value"}. Complete record object should be passed along with the primary key.
an optional callback method called on successful invocation of the variable.
an optional callback method called on error invocation of the variable.
